name: loading-overlay
title: Loading overlay
description: Covers a card, table or form while it refreshes with a scrim, a spinner and a label, and makes the stale content inert so it cannot be clicked or tabbed into.
docs: Wrap the region and set loading. delay (default 200 ms) keeps a quick refresh from flashing the overlay, and minDuration (default 400 ms) keeps it from blinking once it is up. Give the component the radius of the region it covers, for example className="rounded-xl". The content is made inert and aria-busy while the overlay shows; focus that was inside it is parked on the overlay and handed back.
